cardinality.rule: Events.VOLUME_VIEWPORT_SCROLL: no event fires for each scroll: listen to NEW_IMAGE for the slice that is shown and to CAMERA_MODIFIED for the camera; a scroll stopped at the first or the last slice fires SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS
detail.imageIdIndex: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS gives sliceIndex, the position the scroll stopped at (the first or the last), where the old event gave the position before the scroll
Types.EventTypes.VolumeScrollOutOfBoundsEvent: the detail is { viewportId, renderingEngineId, displaySetId, volumeId, sliceIndex, numberOfSlices, delta, direction, imageId }
Types.EventTypes.VolumeScrollOutOfBoundsEventDetail: the detail is { viewportId, renderingEngineId, displaySetId, volumeId, sliceIndex, numberOfSlices, delta, direction, imageId }
detail.currentStepIndex: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS gives sliceIndex, the position the scroll stopped at (the first or the last), where the old event gave the position before the scroll
detail.numScrollSteps: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS gives numberOfSlices, which is numScrollSteps + 1
detail.viewport: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS gives viewportId and renderingEngineId: getEnabledElementByIds(viewportId, renderingEngineId).viewport
